Shivarudrappa Umesh Yeshwanthpur
[[Shivarudrappa Umesh Yeshwanthpur]] 是 [[R18 CSI enhancements for high-speed Scenario]] 中列為 Applications of CSI reports in DL expert person 的人名，括號單位 / 群組標示為 `1WS6`。

R&S TS-LBS › 來源中的角色
依 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]]：

- Smart phone RED Art3.3g 的 special requirement 是 E112 / emergency service。
- 來源說 all smartphones sold in the European Union have to be compliant as of March 17, 2022 with [[Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019-320]]。
- 該 regulation defines that 112 emergency calls provide caller location information to emergency services in a fast and accurate way。
- 來源指出 when there is no EN standard available，Notified body has to be involved。
- 來源稱 [[R&S TS-LBS]] location-based services test system is the first test solution available to perform the necessary LBS compliance tests。

Shivarudrappa Umesh Yeshwanthpur › 來源中的角色
依 [[R18 CSI enhancements for high-speed Scenario]]：

- 在 MAC / development discussion 後，來源列出 `Expert persons on: Applications of CSI reports in DL`。
- 該欄列名 `Shivarudrappa Umesh Yeshwanthpur (1WS6)`。

來源未提供其職稱、公司 email、正式組織、職責範圍或是否為 feature owner。

R&S TS8996 › 41 GHz to 325 GHz system extension
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- System extension for 5G FR2：**41 GHz to 325 GHz**，including system verification。
- Receive units：[[TC-RSE60]]、[[TC-RSE90]]、[[TC-RSE140]]、[[TC-RSE220]]、[[TC-RSE325]]。
- Multiplier units：[[TC-MX60]]、[[TC-MX90]]、[[TC-MX140]]、[[TC-MX220]]、[[TC-MX325]]。
- Example 220 GHz to 325 GHz：receive unit attached to receiver / analyzer via IF and LO；multiplier unit used for system check and calibration and connected to signal generator；control and power supply via [[OSP]]。
- 系統圖列出 [[R&S ELEKTRA]] software、[[R&S ESW44]] with B21、LO / IF、[[R&S CMX500]]、[[OSP220]] with B153B、power supply + control、[[R&S SMB100A]]。
- RX Modules automation：Positioner EAP 可自動定位，linear x-y accuracy ±2 mm，polarization ±1°；combined receive unit 41 GHz to 325 GHz。
- Test receiver with OSP can be operated in EMC chamber via fiber optic and located directly behind the positioner。
- ELEKTRA supports automatic band and polarization change during continuous 3D measurement，以及 maximum search over x / y / polarization / azimuth / elevation。

R&S TS8991 › 來源中的角色
依 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]]：

- 來源在 cellular technology RF test for radio spectrum Art3.2 投影片中指出 5G NR specification includes FR1 and FR2。
- FR1 test setup stays conducted；FR2 test setup becomes radiated。
- 來源把 CTIA-OTA test cases 與 3GPP test cases 並列，並寫 almost the same RF conformance test cases in 3GPP。
- 同頁列出 Receiver Total Radiated Sensitivity / TRS、Total Radiated Power / TRP，並將 [[R&S TS8991]] 放在 radiated / OTA test context。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 [[EN 303 981]] 測試描述為 antenna characterizations 的 radiated measurement，列出 antenna beam pointing、off/on-axis spurious radiation、carrier suppression / cessation、blocking performance、adjacent signal selectivity、image frequency rejection、WBES location / identification、control and monitoring functions、receive antenna off-axis gain pattern，並連到 [[R&S SMBV100B]]、[[R&S ELEKTRA]]、[[R&S TS8996]]。
- 來源列出 FCC CFR47 §25 Mobile Satellite Service / Mobile Earth Station test items：RF output power、occupied bandwidth、emission mask within 25% of authorized BW、out of band emissions、additional unwanted emission 1559–1610 MHz、carrier-off state emissions 1559–1610 MHz、frequency stability，並提到 ANSI C63.26 / FCC KDBs。
- 最後來源把 primary test instruments for wireless regulatory test labs 分成 wireless communication tester、EMI test receiver、signal & spectrum analyzer、network analyzer、vector signal generator、broadband amplifier 等類別。

passages.text:
R&S ELEKTRA › Wireless EMC / EMS extension
[[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]] 另列出 wireless EMC / EMS 相關功能：

- Wireless EMC Extension: EMI tests for wireless devices；radiated and conducted emission test according ETSI EN 301 489；signaling also in EMI measurements supported。
- EMS tests for wireless devices：susceptibility tests according [[TS 134.124]] and ETSI EN 301 489。
- Signaling options include link quality measurement for wireless devices with data application，例如 BER、BLER、FER、PER。
- Radiated EMS tests for wireless devices with audio：susceptibility tests according TS 134.124 and ETSI EN 301 489；audio measurement for wireless devices with audio functionality。
- ELEKTRA option [[ELEMS-ABT]]；uses external audio analyzer or CMW internal audio analyzer；application note available with detailed setup description。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源指出 smartphone Art 3.3g / [[Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019-320]] / E112 是沒有 ETSI EN standard 的 regulatory compliance requirement；當沒有 EN standard available 時需 Notified body involved，並稱 [[R&S TS-LBS]] 是 first test solution available to perform the necessary LBS compliance tests。
- [[FCC 無線設備法規測試]]部分列出 [[47 CFR]]、[[ANSI C63.26]]、[[ANSI C63.10]]、[[IEEE Std 1528-2013]]、[[C63.19]] 等測試依據，並列出 licensed cellular CFR47 test items：RF power output、modulation characteristics、occupied bandwidth、band edge、spurious emissions、frequency stability、peak to average ratio、field strength of spurious radiation。
- 來源以 [[ITU-R SM.329-12]] 與 [[47 CFR §2.1057]] 對照 CE RED / FCC 的 frequency range：5G NR FR1 的 CE RED 30 MHz–26 GHz、FCC 9 kHz–40 GHz；5G NR FR2 的 CE RED 30 MHz–90 GHz、FCC 9 kHz–200 GHz；並提到 [[R&S FSV3000]] / [[R&S FSVA3000]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S ESW]]。
- [[NTN 裝置法規測試]]部分把 NTN device implementation 分成 proprietary、3GPP < R16、3GPP R17 NTN-IoT、reuse spectrum assets / 3GPP unmodified UE 等路徑，例子包含 iPhone 14 / Globalstar、Qualcomm / Iridium、MTK / Bullitt / Skylo、AT&T / AST Space Mobile、T-Mobile / Starlink、Optus / Lynk。
- 來源列出衛星 / NTN 相關 EN standards：[[EN 301 441]]、[[EN 301 442]]、[[EN 301 444]]、[[EN 301 681]]、[[EN 302 574]]、[[EN 303 981]]，並將 iPhone14、Bullitt defy satellite link、StarLink Dish 作為 DoC / market product examples。
- 來源將 [[EN 301 681]] 測試偏向 conducted measurement，列出 spectrum analyzer、signal generator、BER measure / system emulator / mobile radio tester 等 required instruments，並明示 latest [[R&S CMW500]] software can support 3GPP R17 NB-NTN signalling。

R&S TS9982 EMS Test System › 來源中的角色
依 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]]：

- [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]] 同列於 Traditional EMC Art 3.1b tests。
- 上下文是 [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]] Art 3.1b [[EMC]] requirements。
- 來源指出 Art 3.1b EMC test requirements are not changed by 5G NR。
- EMC tests need both enable radio and disable radio conditions, which means signaling solution for 5G NR。
- Mobile phones require [[Audio Breakthrough]] test, from GSM to VoLTE and VoNR by 5G。
- 來源稱 R&S EMC Systems cover 5G NR functionality, powered by latest [[R&S CMX500]]。

SPEAG combines CMX500 OBT with the DASY8-3D system for automated SAR testing of 5G NR devices › 重點摘要
- 來源是 [[Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co KG]] 發布的 PR，原始網頁標題為 SPEAG combines CMX500 OBT with the DASY8-3D system for automated SAR testing of 5G NR devices；來源 frontmatter `published` 空白，未標示發布日期，raw created 為 2026-09-11。
- [[SPEAG]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 擴大長期合作，將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 與 [[DASY8-3D]] 的 [[Specific Absorption Rate]] measurement system 結合，並利用 enhanced [[DASY8 Application Programming Interface]]。
- 來源稱此組合讓 wireless device manufacturers 能對 [[5G NR]] [[NR FR1]] devices 執行 [[5G NR SAR testing]]。
- 來源描述 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 可 emulates a [[5G NR]] [[NR FR1]] base station，滿足 5G NR device SAR testing requirements，並提升 test engineer ease of use。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] radio communication tester 在單一儀器中支援 cellular technologies，如 [[LTE]]、[[5G NR]]，以及 non-cellular technologies，如 [[Wi-Fi]]。
- 來源把 [[NR-NTN]]、[[5G RedCap]] 與 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 稱為 latest test feature sets / state-of-the-art wireless technologies，使 [[R&S CMX500]] 成為 long-term, future-proof callbox platform；來源未列 option code、CSW version 或正式 configuration。
- 來源說 cell phones、smart watches、AR/XR goggles 等靠近人體運作的 wireless products 需要確保 SAR values 符合 regulatory requirements。
- 來源列出 [[FCC]]、[[ISED]] 與 [[European Union]] 已建立 stringent SAR regulations，並說 China、Vietnam、India 等國近年逐步採用類似的 radio equipment SAR market access regulation requirements。
- 來源稱全球許多 regulatory test labs 與 market surveillance test labs 配備 [[SPEAG]] systems 進行 SAR testing。
- Press & media contact 為 [[Christian Mokry]]，職稱 PR Manager Test & measurement，電話 +49 89 412913052，email press@rohde-schwarz.com。

- [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（封面日期 2026.3.4）封面標題為 **What is Serdes and SI/PI?**。
- [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（2026.3.4）把 R&S Group div 1 targets 寫成 **Digital**、**Power**、**RF**。
- [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（2026.3.4）在 Slide 11 以 **Transmission Channel and validation challenges electrical Interfaces** 描述高速電性介面的驗證挑戰。
- Slide 11 的資料路徑示意包含 Tx、Rx、Channel、Tx Package、PCBs、Connectors、Rx Package、EQ (FFE)、EQ (CTLE, DFE)、ADC + DSP、DSP + DAC 等圖上文字。
- Slide 11 將測試 / 驗證區塊連到儀器類型：Interface Test 對應 scopes、BERTs、AWGs、switch matrices；RefClk and PLL jitter performance 對應 phase noise analyzers 與 signal generators；[[Power Distribution Network]] 對應 scopes 與 network analyzers；ADC / DAC frontend performance 對應 spectrum analyzers 與 signal generators。
- Slide 20 題為 **Signal integrity flow of high speed PCB/PCBA**，列出 [[IL]] / [[Xtalk]] / [[Eye diagram]]、[[TDR Impedance]]、[[Stackup Planner]]、[[TL Calculator]]。
